verdict.rationale: v0 docs explicitly state the ability to 'Clone pages with screenshots or Figma files' and 'Create high-fidelity UIs from your wireframes or mockups,' directly matching the story of importing a design and having the builder implement it. However, this is only first-party documentation with no independent/hands-on verification of Figma-specific import fidelity or workflow details. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of Figma import fidelity, detailed workflow/API specifics for Figma ingestion beyond a single doc bullet.
